output.reason: Covered export-oriented labour-intensive companies may cut wages to as little as 75% of the usual wage for six months. This lowers the regular gross income of affected permanent employees. Pasal 12 also requires social security contributions to keep using the last wage before the cut. So employer-paid JKK/JKM/JKN premiums included in gross income, and employee JHT/JP deductions, stay on the old wage rather than the reduced one. Both points change PPh 21 calculation inputs for affected permanent employees during the period.
